subject: TEST CONFIRMED: stale prewarm can steal shell lease owner; Gen3 CAS model passes 10/10
body: Against CURRENT main 45bb0d326899c0e08415928224cfea0ff58d2d4e, a source-faithful isolated Kotlin harness reproduced the cover-lease ownership race. Baseline sequence: newer generation 20 prewarms first and reaches HELD leaseId=1 epoch=1 ownerGeneration=20; delayed older generation 10 prewarm arrives second; current Fold7CoverPanelLease.beginPrewarm() in HELD state increments epoch and sets ownerGeneration=10 without an expected-token check; resulting state HELD leaseId=1 epoch=2 ownerGeneration=10. A generation-20 release is then rejected because owner no longer matches. Baseline harness compiled with kotlinc and executed successfully. Gen3 prototype uses exact compare-and-swap ownership: prewarm/adoption requires the current shell-session/lease/epoch/owner token, and all mutations carry immutable serviceEpoch+closeCycleId+transitionGeneration identity. Stale/duplicate calls fail inertly. Gen3 adversarial harness compiled and executed 10 scenarios: old-after-new, stale captured token, same-cycle retry, duplicate retry, stale release, current release, release/reclose, shell restart token, service restart token, triple reversal. RESULT=10/10 passed. This proves a deterministic model-level source race and a model-level architectural mitigation; Fold7 device validation remains required. No GitHub writes performed.
